title: Super Egg Drop
description: Find the minimum number of moves to determine the highest floor from which an egg will not break, given K eggs and N floors.
pseudocode:
1. dp[moves][eggs] = floors_covered
2. while dp[m][K] < N:
3.   m++
4.   for k from 1 to K:
5.     dp[m][k] = dp[m-1][k-1] + 1 + dp[m-1][k]
6. return m

steps.note: Initialize DP table for K=2 eggs, N=6 floors. m=0, dp[0][2]=0
Calculate floors covered with 1 move: dp[1][1]=1, dp[1][2]=1
Calculate floors covered with 2 moves: dp[2][1]=2, dp[2][2]=1+1+1=3
Calculate floors covered with 3 moves: dp[3][1]=3, dp[3][2]=2+1+3=6
Target 6 floors reached in 3 moves. Return m=3
